phaseHistory.name: Validate Spec
phaseHistory.findings: 2 blockers fixed inline: AC-8 was a set-diff claiming to be a region check (misses the REQ-596/597 orphaned-comment defect); AC-5 was vacuous (existing test guards run_prompt_turn's post-claim re-read, upstream of any TurnContext). 4 warnings fixed: AC-1 split into vestigial vs earned, AC-2 disambiguated, AC-10 fixture provenance pinned, AC-3 llama feature-gate limit recorded. OQ-3 answered (no shared cluster; engine.rs/category.rs/main.rs/budget.rs out of scope). OQ-4 raised: two clusters in runtime.rs, not one.

phaseHistory.name: Architect & Tasks
phaseHistory.note: 6 ADRs. ADR-3 answers OQ-1 (route stays a parameter - it is reassigned per fallback reroute inside run_one_attempt's 'turn loop). ADR-4 found that BR-2 names one instance of a class: the REQ-580 warming hold shadow-rebinds router after the claim, so a BR-2-compliant construction point can still capture a stale router. Added BR-2.1.

phaseHistory.name: Validate Architecture
phaseHistory.findings: 2 fixed inline: BR-3 (request-id minting) and BR-7 (cap-exempt tool visibility) had no task coverage. BR-4 had only an incidental grep hit; given explicit coverage in TASK-294 (construction does no I/O) and TASK-296.

notes: Phase 1 empirical baseline: 25 attributes, but only 16 suppress a firing lint. 9 vestigial = 2 AC-2 duplicates + 5 *_route fns (exactly 7 args, at threshold) + 2 engine.rs (llama feature-gated, never compiled by CI or AC-3).

Phase 2 ADR-4: highest-risk finding. run_prompt_turn shadow-rebinds `router` at the REQ-580 warming hold (after the claim). A TurnContext built at the first router binding satisfies BR-2 and still breaks REQ-580's guarantee. Construction point is after the hold's match resolves.
